title: Vibroacoustics of pipes : analysis of coincidence effects between acoustic and mechanical resonances.
author: Joăo Vitor Fontenele Romero
abstract: In the present work, it is developed an analytical method to predict the wall vibration effects in a wind music instrument's input acoustic impedance. This method is compared with experimental results and can be used for any support condition of the instrument, treated as a cylindrical shape, with a model of its cross section's geometrical imperfections. A numerical simulation can also compare the influence of the wall vibrations' vibroacoustic phenomena with the acoustic impedance of an instrument with rigid walls.
